title: Satay Chicken with Black Bean Sauce
description: A fusion of Malaysian flavors with the addition of luscious and savory black bean sauce. This satay recipe combines the classic Southeast Asian dish with the deep flavors of black beans.

ingredients.name: Malaysian satay seasoning blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian grocery stores

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together satay seasoning blend, peanut sauce, and honey.
3. Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
4. Brush the grill grates with sesame oil to prevent sticking.
5. Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, heat the black bean sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.
7. To serve, place a piece of grilled chicken on a skewer or in a bowl.
8. Spoon the black bean sauce over the top of the chicken.
9. Garnish with chopped peanuts and cilantro.
10. Serve with a side of luscious coconut milk for dipping (optional).
